visible_observation: The three product visuals are identical in geometry (a headband arc and two vertical pill-shaped earcups) and differ only in the fill color of the earcups (blue, orange, purple). The structural silhouette of the 'Air', 'Studio', and 'Nocturne' is exactly the same.
critique: The design fails to give each product a 'meaningful visual personality connected to its intended use.' By using a single, generic SVG shape for all three, the products feel like the same item in different paint jobs. The 'Air' (lightweight) looks just as bulky as the 'Nocturne' (flagship), and the 'Studio' (creative/accurate) lacks any visual cue of precision or technical depth. This flattens the distinct identities the brief explicitly requested.
revision: Modify the inline SVG for each product to reflect its specific character: 1) Make the 'Air' earcups significantly thinner and more tapered to suggest lightness. 2) Add a visible circular driver ring or mesh texture to the 'Studio' earcups to suggest technical accuracy. 3) Make the 'Nocturne' earcups larger and more rounded/organic to suggest immersive, premium comfort.
protected_strength: The consistent vertical layout, the unified dark background, and the clear 'Recommended' highlight on the center card must remain to ensure the comparison system stays disciplined and easy to scan.
